why_saturated: Diagonal potrf is latency/serial-bound (~14.6 TFLOP/s achieved) -> cuSOLVER already near the serial-dependency floor.
batch=1 -> no batch parallelism to fill the ~148 SMs during the serial factorization (the exp-065 overlap only helps MID shapes because they batch many 128-blocks).
Op-level blocking of the nb block is MEASURED slower: exp064 blocked_leaf1024_tf32 = 1089us vs cuSOLVER 676us; the per-call potrf floor does not amortize.
Single-CTA fused megakernel = 1 SM = ~100x SM-starved vs cuSOLVER's whole-GPU trailing; 2048/4096 FP32 block (16-64MB) is not shared-memory resident.

Multi-CTA fused megakernel needs cross-SM sync (cooperative grid.sync or software global barriers) -> popcorn-BANNED (lessons.md Part 2; QR cooperative -47% / software barrier -42%, 'worked but banned'). Would win on Modal but be an unshippable hollow number.

Per-call overhead is already tiny on these shapes: diagonal-only isfinite check, no copy-in clone.
